text:
ryan: buildlinkcheck failing intermittently on main. example: /guides/setup#env-vars -> sometimes 404, sometimes ok. logs show ordering differs in the mkdocs toc generator. https://ci.redwood/infer-docs/4312/logs

anya: could be nondeterministic file iteration on different workers. are we using glob with unordered traversal?

zhen: yes, the include step used pathlib.glob which is OS-dependent ordering. changed in #4320 but maybe we missed a spot.

ryan: how to make it stable quick patch?

zhen: sort the glob results before assembly. I can push a patch to docs-build that canonicalizes include ordering.

docbot: suggested patch: sort(paths, key=str.lower) before processing includes.

anya: also add a test that runs the build twice and diffs the output HTML tree; CI should fail if output differs. that'll catch nondeterminism going forward.

zhen: opening PR #4323 with ordering fix + deterministic-build test.

docbot: running tests in PR 4323...

docs-ci: tests: deterministic-build diff -> PASS

ryan: nice. does this address the localized builds too?

zhen: yes, sorting is applied earlier in the pipeline before locale splitting. should stabilize de/fr as well.

deploy-bot: staging build started for docs/stable-ordering -> linkcheck run

docs-ci: linkcheck: all fragments resolved. intermittent failures not reproducible after patch.

anya: follow-up: add a small note in docs contributors guide about deterministic build expectations and why sorting includes matters. saving future confusion.

zhen: will add contributor guide blurb in the PR.

ryan: thanks team. closing once deploy is live.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded -> docs site live.
